en.bdb: Like a crane the cheats cannot get fruits of labour  -

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਲੋਗ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡਾਂ ਦੇ ਆਇ ਜੁੜੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: teerath purab sa(n)jog log chahu ku(n)ddaa(n) dhe aai juRa(n)dhe|

en.bdb: On pilgrimage centres, because of the anniversary festivals, millions of people get together from all the four directions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan chhia dharasanaa naam dhaan isanaan kara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The followers of six philosophies and the four varnas make recitations, charities and take ablutions there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: jap tap sa(n)jam hom jag varat nem kar vedh suna(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Performing recitations, offering burnt offerings, fast and undertaking rigorous disciples, they listen to the recitals from the vedas.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਥਾਨ ਪੁਜੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: giaan dhiaan simaran jugat dhevee dhev sathaan puja(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Meditating, they adopt they techniques of recitations.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਗਾ ਬਗੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਪਰਾਧਿ ਨਿਵੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: bagaa bage kapaRe kar samaadh aparaadh niva(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Worship of gods and goddesses is performed at their respective abodes - temples.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਨ ਚਾਲ ਚਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun gurmukh pa(n)th na chaal chala(n)dhe|

en.bdb: White-clad persons remain engaged in trance but like a crane as and when they get opportunity they immediately stoop to commit crime.
Listening to the word of the Guru in the holy congregation, the fake lovers who do not adopt it in their life, do not attain any fruit (in their life).
